close_reason: Quarantined remaining semantic/transport planner jobs as legacy diagnostic surfaces, audited product-path consumers, and verified pull-path plus guardrail tests.
description:
Goal
After product transport/effects/front doors are real, classify the remaining legacy semantic/transport jobs and delete what is no longer production. SealSemanticClosure, DeriveRuntimeDemand, DeriveExecutableTransport, DeriveTransportPlan, SemanticReady, SemanticClosed, ExecutableTransport, TransportPlan, and root_executable_frontier must not be ambient production vocabulary for the artifact path.

Signal
rg shows no production artifact/backend/native/macro consumer of legacy semantic closure or root transport plan. Any remaining references are either deleted or explicitly marked legacy diagnostic/test surfaces with tickets for eventual removal. root_executable_frontier is absent from production or guarded by failing telemetry if called from product execution.

Strategy
Work from consumers backward: backend/native/macro/dump first, then tests, then job/fact variants and world stores. Do not delete a still-needed semantic fact by guessing; prove no consumer remains or create the next blocking ticket.

Removal steps
- Delete dead Job variants and match arms for SealSemanticClosure/DeriveRuntimeDemand/DeriveExecutableTransport/DeriveTransportPlan if no non-legacy consumer remains.
- Delete FactKey variants and stores for SemanticReady/SemanticClosed/ExecutableTransport/TransportPlan once consumers are gone.
- Delete World::root_executable_frontier or move it behind test-only legacy helpers with an explicit removal ticket.
- Delete semantic_closed telemetry captures and tests that pin old closure behavior unless they are moved to a legacy diagnostic module.
- Delete docs/comments that describe the seal or root transport plan as the artifact path.

Verification
rg audit; cargo test -q --lib compiler2_pull_; targeted legacy tests if intentionally retained; 00181 no-dump telemetry has zero forbidden jobs across roots.
title: Pull cleanup: quarantine or delete legacy semantic and transport jobs
